summary: perf-load (daily-perf-load in the daily long lanes and perf-load in the Performance workflow) gets 60 minutes instead of 30, so a cold run on a new snapshot recipe can finish and seed the build and store snapshots

compatibility.detail: No required check or ruleset change. Snapshot publication is unchanged: it still happens only after a complete workload report, on main or the same PR. Daily run 39488050274 missed both snapshots, compiled for 10m38s, generated stores for 966s and was cancelled at 30 minutes before any snapshot was saved.

manual.detail: None. The next daily run on main seeds the current recipe if it finishes cold within 60 minutes.
